node.statement: Nonvanishing branch. Decrease e_0 so that e_0<=1 and b*e_0<=1. If T is nonvanishing, then (iv) gives ||T||<=2. Bilinearity and T^2=TT give T(T^2)-T=T(T^2-T)+(T^2-T). Thus (ii), ||T^2-T||<=delta, and (iii) imply ||u_T-T||<=||u_T-(L_T R_T)(T)||+||T(T^2)-T||<=k*e*||T||+(1+epsilon)||T||*delta+delta<=(2*k+5)*e. The reverse triangle inequality and (iv) now yield abs(||u_T||-1)<=abs(||u_T||-||T||)+abs(||T||-1)<=(2*k+5+b)*e; in particular ||u_T||<=1+(2*k+5+b)*e.
